newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Swire adds 64 units to Island Plc presale.
newsitem.headline: Swire adds 64 units to Island Plc presale.

text.p: Swire Properties Ltd said on Thursday it would add 64 units to the 48 already on offer in the pre-sale of flats in its Island Place development.
By Thursday, the 48 original flats on offer were 14 times oversubscribed with 721 applications received since registration opened on Tuesday, Swire said in a statement.
Applicants on Thursday were a balanced mix of both users and invesors, it added.
Swire said 160 applications were received on Tuesday, 232 on Wednesday and 329 on Thursday. Registration closes on Friday and results will be announced on Sunday.
Prices of the original 48 ranged averaged HK$6,282 per sq ft, and prices of the 64 added would be available on Friday.
Island Place is a residential and commercial development jointly owned by Swire and China Motor Bus Co Ltd.
